content.bridge_context: Transitioning from elementary arithmetic to algebraic thinking, this chapter introduces the beauty of regularity and rules in numbers and shapes.

units.title: What is a Pattern?
units.explanation: A pattern is a series or sequence that repeats or follows a specific rule.
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at the sequence: 2, 4, 6, 8... What comes next? / इस क्रम को देखें: 2, 4, 6, 8... अगला क्या होगा?

units.title: Patterns in Nature
units.explanation: Regularity is found in petals of flowers, honeycombs, and even in how we count.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of a pattern you see in your house. / अपने घर में दिखने वाले किसी पैटर्न के बारे में सोचें।
